name: Moosewood: Camp Roleplay
desc:
👍 New Stamps Code at 2k Likes!

☀️ Moosewood Summer Camp is a game where summer never ends! Make new friends as a Camper, or lead your cabin as a Counselor!

🎟️ Gain free Stamps by playing for 10 minutes daily!
